book_title: The Old Cranberry Ladies Garden Club: The Ghost and The Key
author: Bill Cusano
book_description: With a pitchfork through the man's groin and another through his chest, it is clear that someone had murdered Chester H. Cranberry. It's not something that could have happened accidentally. But that was 192 years ago. With the discovery of a key piece of evidence that Chester's wife, Elcira, murdered him, If she had, she couldn't legally inherit the property. Mildred Cranberry, the current family matriarch, faces the prospect of losing her property altogether. Mildred will need more than the Old Cranberry Ladies Garden Club to help her hold onto her family home, especially since one member wants to see her fail. She may need to call on Elcira herself to unravel this mess. Can she trust the ghost of the suspected widow murderess to do that?Show more
